note: The decoded gate row this recipe reached when it shipped. npm run qa:cover-recipes re-renders it through motion.mjs cover and fails when median d or the moving share leaves +-15 % of this row, seamLocal leaves TARGET, the file passes 2 MiB or the render exits non-zero. Measured on the GPU rung (Apple ANGLE Metal on Apple silicon; the software rung fallback renders the same frames more slowly) and libwebp 1.6.0.

treatment.request: A README motion cover for LitGrok with a hero you can turn in your head.
treatment.idea: One rounded hero turns once per loop under a key light while the brand word sits live over it.
treatment.recipeReason: The subject has a back and an inside, so the loop is an object, not a drawing.

layers.slow: The shadow slides under the turning hero once per loop.
layers.mid: The hero turns once per loop, showing every side.
layers.beat: The brand word holds still over the turn.

system.rule: One full turn per loop, eased at neither end.
system.copies: One hero and the brand word.
system.offset: The turn is the loop phase itself.

treatment.ambition: The turn reads as one object and the seam is invisible in the decoded file.
